info.title: typecastlm
info.description: A Jev-class decision model with open weights, behind the Jev API: ask the material a closed question, get a probability back. Send the key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` when the service asks for one; `GET /health` never does. The reference with the reasoning behind each field is docs/API.md.

get.summary: Which model, where, in what form, with which wording
The model this service holds, and its alias

401.description: The service requires a key and the `Authorization` header does not carry it.

503.description: No model is loaded: a backend is being switched, or none could be started; `/admin` says which.

post.summary: The same route under its 1.0.0 name
post.description:
Answer one or more questions about the content supplied in `state`.

Question types may be mixed in one request. Answers come back under the names the
questions were sent under, each of the type its question has. The state is read once
for the bundle: the questions' common prefix runs once and their tails continue from
it, so `usage` counts the state once and each question's tail.

529.description: The model is busy and the line for it is full; `Retry-After` says in how many seconds to come back.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: The option with the highest probability.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Probability of each option, keyed by its name; they sum to 1.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The probability of the chosen option.

marks.title: Marks
marks.description: Which letter each option was given, in the order the request listed them. Absent when proxied.

ChoiceAnswer.title: ChoiceAnswer
ChoiceAnswer.description: The option chosen, and how likely each was.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: What the model should decide when choosing an option.
examples: What is the tone of this message?

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Option names and descriptions of when each applies, 2 to 26 of them. An option without a description is read by its name alone. Options are marked A, B, C… in this order, and the order moves the answer.

ChoiceQuestion.title: ChoiceQuestion
ChoiceQuestion.description: One of several named options, with a probability for each.

detail.title: Detail
examples: Missing or invalid API key. Check the `Authorization` header.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Where the model is: `local` (the weights in this process), `llama` (a llama-server with the GGUF), `openai` (a server speaking /v1/embeddings) or `jev` (proxied to TypeSafe's Jev).

status.title: Status
status.description: `ready`, `loading` while a backend is being switched or downloaded, `error` when none is loaded; then the `/v1` routes answer 503.

model.title: Model
model.description: The checkpoint as it was loaded: a Hub id or a path.

name.title: Name
name.description: Its short name, the one answers carry.

device.title: Device
device.description: The device for a local backend, the server's address for a remote one.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Where the wording came from: the model directory, the model repository, or `override: <path>`.

auth.title: Auth
auth.description: Whether the `/v1` routes require a key.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: `ok`, or what does not fit the interface.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: The deployment: which checkpoint, where, with which wording — what your numbers came from.

busy.title: Busy
busy.description: Whether a request holds the model right now.

running.title: Running
running.description: Requests on the backend at this moment.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: How many may be on it at once: 1 for weights held here.

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: How many may wait before the next gets 529.

avg_ms.title: Avg Ms
avg_ms.description: Exponential mean of a request's time on the model.

name.title: Name
name.description: A name the request's `model` may carry.

noul.title: Noul
noul.description: Probability of yes, a softmax over the two answers that decide the question at the `verdict` temperature. The verdict is `noul >= 0.5`.

logits.title: Logits
logits.description: The raw outputs for true, false and unsure, before any temperature. Absent when the model is proxied: Jev returns probabilities alone.

true.title: True
true.description: What counts as a yes answer.

false.title: False
false.description: What counts as a no answer.
examples: The message is a legitimate conversation.

NoulCriteria.title: NoulCriteria
NoulCriteria.description: What counts as a yes and what counts as a no.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: The yes/no question or statement to evaluate.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: What a yes and a no mean — two of them. Left out, the wording shipped with the weights is used.

NoulQuestion.title: NoulQuestion
NoulQuestion.description: A yes/no question, answered with the probability of yes.

score.title: Score
score.description: Expected level: the probability-weighted mean of the positions, so it falls between levels.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: Each position and the level it names.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Probability of each level, keyed by position; they sum to 1.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The probability of the leading level.

marks.title: Marks
marks.description: Which mark each level was given; absent when proxied.

ScoreAnswer.title: ScoreAnswer
ScoreAnswer.description: The expected level, and how likely each level was.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a rating against ordered levels. `scale` is a synonym.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Ordered descriptions of the levels; a list gives them positions 0, 1, 2… and those positions key the answer, a map keeps your keys. At least two; ten is the recommended limit and 36 the hard one.

ScoreQuestion.title: ScoreQuestion
ScoreQuestion.description: A level on an ordinal rubric, with the expected level and a probability per level.

model.title: Model
model.description: A Hub repository or a directory: the weights for `local`, `prompt.json` and `head.json` for an embedding backend, the upstream model name for `jev`.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: A wording file instead of the shipped one.

backend_endpoint.title: Backend Endpoint
backend_endpoint.description: The embedding server or the upstream API.

backend_key.title: Backend Key
backend_key.description: Its token; empty keeps the one already set.

backend_key_set.title: Backend Key Set
backend_key_set.description: Read-only: whether a token is stored.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description:
What `/admin` shows and changes: where the model is and how it is read. The keys are
never echoed back, only whether one is set.

since.title: Since
since.description: Unix time the current status began.

state.title: State
state.description: The content all questions in this request refer to. An object or an array is read as JSON.
examples: I was charged twice. Please help.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Questions to ask about the content, each under a name you choose. The response uses those names to identify the answers.

model.title: Model
model.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored: a process serves one checkpoint, and the answer names it. `GET /v1/models` lists the names.

SystemOneRequest.title: SystemOneRequest
SystemOneRequest.description: Questions about one piece of material.

model.title: Model
model.description: The checkpoint that answered, under its short name.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: One answer per question, under the key you sent; its type matches the question's.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.description: The temperature per mode the probabilities were read at — `verdict`, `three_answers`, `choice`, `scale`, each `{"temperature": t}` — so `logits` can be re-read. May carry a `note`.

SystemOneResponse.title: SystemOneResponse
SystemOneResponse.description: Answers keyed by question name, with the model used and token usage.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Probability of each of the three answers at the `three_answers` temperature; they sum to 1.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The probability of the leading answer.

native.title: Native
native.description: False when the server has no `tfu` of its own and the question was asked as a `choice` with a third option — a proxied Jev.

TfuAnswer.title: TfuAnswer
TfuAnswer.description: One distribution over true, false and unsure.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a question read over true, false and unsure.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: The same two criteria as `noul`; `unsure` is what is left when neither fits and is never written.

TfuQuestion.title: TfuQuestion
TfuQuestion.description: The same question as `noul`, read over three answers: true, false, unsure.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Tokens read, summed over the questions.

HTTPBearer.description: The key the service was started with.
